comments.author: Ameow
comments.body_html:
If .zip file only includes “BepInEx” or “user” directory, drop it into your root directory of sptarkov. If includes something like “xxx.dll”, drop it into /BepInEx/plugins. If includes a directory with name, drop it into “/user/mods”.
This should help you to install all kind of mods XD.
